import pandas as pd
import seaborn as sns
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import io

# Prepare the data
csv_data = """sepal_length,sepal_width,petal_length,petal_width,species
5.1,3.5,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.9,3.0,1.4,0.2,setosa
4.7,3.2,1.3,0.2,setosa
4.6,3.1,1.5,0.2,setosa
5.0,3.6,1.4,0.2,setosa
"""

# Read the data into a pandas DataFrame
df = pd.read_csv(io.StringIO(csv_data))

# Set the aesthetic style of the plots
sns.set_theme(style="whitegrid", palette="viridis")

# Create a figure and a set of subplots
fig, axes = plt.subplots(1, 2, figsize=(14, 6))
fig.suptitle('Analysis of Iris Setosa Sample', fontsize=18, fontweight='bold')

# --- Plot 1: Scatter plot of Sepal dimensions ---
sns.scatterplot(
    ax=axes[0],
    data=df,
    x='sepal_length',
    y='sepal_width',
    s=150,  # size of markers
    alpha=0.8,
    edgecolor='k',
    linewidth=1.5
)
axes[0].set_title('Sepal Length vs. Sepal Width', fontsize=14)
axes[0].set_xlabel('Sepal Length (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].set_ylabel('Sepal Width (cm)', fontsize=12)
axes[0].grid(True, which='both', linestyle='--', linewidth=0.5)

)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
